personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (fused with 7 Dark-First Utility for AI tech structure)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, deeply atmospheric AI orchestrator built on obsidian glass and glowing cyan data streams.

spacing.rule: Generous cinematic spacing for hero areas; tighter utility spacing within data cards.

do's: Apply to Coordination bottom sheet headers and bodies.
Apply to feature cards that sit over photographic hero headers.
Apply to the pinned Guardian Chat suggestion chips.
Pair blur with surfaceSecondary tint at >=75% opacity to guarantee text readability.
dont's: Do not blur standard form fields or deep data settings rows.
Do not use transparent glass without a dark tint underlying it.

screens.name: Landing Page & Cinematic Intro
screens.purpose: A breathtaking first impression showcasing the Toronto skyline and the arrival of the Guardian.

states.error: Message 'Connection to Hub lost.' + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of the Toronto skyline. Dark gradient scrim from bottom (0% -> 90% surface at bottom). The Guardian orb (Skia glowing circle in brandPrimary) descends. Bottom area contains the 'Experience Demo' CTA (glassmorphic pill) and 'Sign in with Google'.

screens.name: Hub (Radial)
screens.purpose: The central nerve center showing the Guardian orb connected to 7 life portals.
screens.layout: Pure surface background (#0a0b0e). Central pulsing Guardian orb (Skia). 7 portal nodes arranged in a circle. Animated Skia cyan lines connect the center to the nodes. A bottom signal banner displays live orchestration text ('Guardian is optimizing Work & Wellbeing...'). Top right: companion switcher.

screens.name: Portal Detail (6 variants: Work, Wellbeing, Home, Style, Community, Relationships)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific life category orchestrated by the Guardian.

states.loading: Skeleton rows with a pulsing brandTertiary tint.
states.empty: Glassmorphic card with 'No active signals' and a primary action.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge photographic hero header (specific to the portal). Heavy vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Back button is a glass FAB. Content scrolls up over the image. First card overlaps the image: a Glassmorphic 'Guardian Intervention' card (e.g., stress meter, breathing session). Below it, stacked solid surfaceSecondary cards for tasks, events, or controls.

screens.name: Coordination Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: A persistent overlay where cross-portal actions are summarized and voiced.
screens.layout: Glassmorphic bottom sheet over the Hub. Includes a drag handle. Top right: Voice Playback FAB (brandPrimary tint). Content is a list of 'Action Cards' detailing cross-portal links (e.g., 'Work meeting moved -> Adjusted Home Thermostat').

screens.name: Guardian View & Chat
screens.purpose: Direct timeline of the AI's logic and conversational interface.

states.empty: 'How can I optimize your day?' + suggestion chips.

screens.layout: Timeline view uses a vertical left-aligned rail (cyan line). 'Signal flow' pills (source -> target). Chat interface uses surfaceSecondary for user bubbles and a brandTertiary glass pill for Guardian bubbles. Sticky suggestion chips at the bottom above the input.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure demo states and toggle Guardian permissions.
screens.layout: Standard dark-utility layout. surface background. surfaceSecondary grouped rows. Ionicons in brandTertiary tinted squares. Segmented controls for switching modes.

screens.name: Demo Walkthrough Overlay
screens.layout: Absolute positioned overlay blocking touches outside the spotlight area. Glassmorphic tooltip box with 'Step X/5', bold title, and a 'Next' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: REJECT 'too white/empty' and 'flat/cheap'. The app must be in pure Dark mode (#0a0b0e) to allow the glowing Skia cyan lines and glassmorphism to pop, creating a premium 'Luxe / Cinematic' feel.
The intro animation should use the 'toronto_skyline_intro' image as a full-bleed backdrop. Apply a heavy dark gradient scrim over it so the Skia Guardian orb (brandPrimary glow) pops beautifully.

For the Hub screen, replace the 'plain circle of portals' with a highly dynamic Skia-driven canvas: a central pulsing orb with animated cyan lines actively flowing to the 7 surrounding portal nodes. The nodes should look like premium glass glassmorphic chips, not flat buttons.

Use expo-blur heavily over photographic headers (like the Guardian Intervention card overlapping the Work/Wellbeing hero photos) and ensure the background image has a vertical gradient scrim under the text to guarantee contrast.

Stick strictly to Satoshi font. The combination of clean geometry, deep obsidian background, and cyan accents achieves the 'Cross-Life Context Intelligence' tech-luxe vibe without resorting to standard Web3 neon overload.
